title: Ruling Out Analyst Scrutiny

purpose.statement: Pay off the 2.2-P5 flag and the 2.5-P4 promise ('tested as a side analysis whose results are reported in Section 4.1') by establishing claim C4: analyst cash-scrutiny does not account for THIS pre-announcement run-up. Deliver the honest three-step rule-out -- (1) the scrutiny measure is real (CashRatio predicts it), (2) scrutiny alone does not move the residual, (3) in the operative reason-gating model scrutiny is null and its interaction with the pre-announcement window is null while the run-up survives -- AFTER first conceding the confound is genuine (scrutiny incidence itself rises pre-announcement). Keep the register NULL-only and underpowered: 'does not account for THIS run-up, not that scrutiny never matters.'
purpose.reason: 2.2 P5 flagged the analyst-scrutiny rival as a real competing hypothesis and 2.5 P4 motivated it as an identification threat with its verdict promised in 4.1; the thesis's identification credibility depends on confronting and bounding the most immediate alternative driver of the run-up. C4 is the ledger's rank-4, NULL-only, underpowered result.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C4 (NULL ONLY, underpowered; 'does not account for THIS run-up; not that scrutiny never matters'; do NOT strengthen)
thesis_draft.tex 2.2 P5 (flag the scrutiny rival; tested in 4.1, L74)
thesis_draft.tex 2.5 P4 (construct + motivation; verdict in 4.1; scrutiny rises pre-announce, L122)

proposition_chain.statement: The scrutiny alternative holds that pre-deal quarters draw harder analyst questions about cash, and that hard questions, not the deal, produce the hedged answers. This confound is genuine, not a strawman: the incidence of cash scrutiny itself rises in the quarter before a cash acquisition (HighCashScrutiny 0.0408**), so it co-moves with both the cash position and the event and could in principle generate the run-up mechanically. (The continuous-volume measure CashScrutiny rises too but insignificantly, 0.0854 n.s., so the genuine confound is the incidence, not the volume.)
proposition_chain.reason: Per the advisor and 2.5-P4, the honest chain must FIRST concede the confound is real, and the plausibility evidence must be the SIGNIFICANT incidence rise (HighCashScrutiny 0.0408**, empire_building_did col 4), NOT the insignificant continuous-volume coefficient. Leading with an n.s. coefficient would self-defeat the 'real rival' premise that 2.2 P5 / 2.5 P4 established. This is why empire_building_did is in 4.1's table list.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C4 (confound_is_real: HighCashScrutiny rises pre-announce 0.0408**, tab:empire_building_did col 4)
thesis_draft.tex 2.5 P4 ('cash scrutiny itself rises in the quarter before a cash acquisition', L122)
numbers: 0.0854 (tab:empire_building_did col 3 CashScrutiny PreAnnounceQtr, SE 0.0749, n.s.) -- continuous volume, insignificant, recast as 'incidence rises, volume does not'

proposition_chain.statement: Step one: the scrutiny measure is real. The share of analyst Q&A turns devoted to cash and liquidity rises strongly with the firm's cash ratio (0.7530***, one-tailed; 0.8519*** with the full control set) and with a high-cash indicator (0.1754***), so the nulls that follow are not the artifact of a dead measure.
proposition_chain.reason: Construct validity (the 2.5-P4.2 ground, the same validity class as the other 2.5 yardsticks) is the precondition that makes the subsequent nulls informative rather than mechanical; this is the first of the three rule-out steps and the promise/delivery split (motivated in 2.5, delivered here).
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C4 (validity_CashRatio_to_Scrutiny 0.7530***/0.8519*** one-tailed; measure is real)
thesis_draft.tex 2.5 P4.2 (CashRatio predicts CashScrutiny 0.7530/0.8519 as ground, L122)

proposition_chain.statement: Step two: scrutiny alone does not move the residual. Its direct effect on UncResCEO is zero to four decimal places (-0.0000, SE 0.0013; 41,512 calls), and the null holds under a logit on the dichotomized residual (-0.0003) and on the raw uncertainty measure and coarser scrutiny proxies alike. This is non-redundant with the residual's construction because CashScrutiny is the VOLUME of cash questions, whereas the question-uncertainty wording (UncQue) is already netted out inside the residual by eq-4.
proposition_chain.reason: The second rule-out step (the direct-effect null) plus the 2.5-P4.4 non-redundancy argument: this test targets the question-volume path eq-4 does not absorb, so the null is meaningful rather than mechanical.
evidence: thesis_draft.tex 2.5 P4.4 (CashScrutiny = volume, distinct from UncQue which eq-4 nets out, L122)
_tables_from_bible.tex tab:cash_scrutiny_channel Panel A (UncResCEO -0.0000) + Panel B (logit -0.0003); N 41,512

proposition_chain.statement: Step three, the operative test: with scrutiny and the pre-announcement indicator in the same model on the cash-acquirer pre-announcement universe, the pre-announcement indicator stays significant (0.0413*** with scrutiny entered, 0.0439** with the interaction added) while scrutiny's own effect is null (0.0000/0.0001) and the scrutiny-by-pre-announcement interaction is insignificant (-0.0056, SE 0.0111). The reason raises uncertainty; the questioning does not, and the questioning does not amplify the reason.
proposition_chain.reason: This is the decisive C4 test: the run-up survives once scrutiny and its interaction with the event window are controlled, so scrutiny does not account for this particular run-up (the within-model dissociation the rule-out rests on).
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C4 (gating_PreAnnounceQtr 0.0413***/0.0439**; gating_CashScrutiny 0.0000/0.0001 n.s.; gating_interaction -0.0056 n.s.)
thesis_draft.tex 2.2 P5.1 (the rival prediction tested in 4.1)
numbers: -0.0056 (tab:reason_gating col 2 CashScrutiny x PreAnnounceQtr, SE 0.0111, n.s.)

proposition_chain.statement: We keep the register honest: this is a failure to find paired with a within-model dissociation, not a powered equivalence test. The interaction's confidence interval (approximately [-0.027, +0.016]) does not exclude effects that would matter against a run-up near 0.04, 89% of calls draw no cash scrutiny at all, and a significant-versus-insignificant contrast is not itself a test. The claim is that scrutiny does not account for THIS run-up, not that scrutiny never matters anywhere.
proposition_chain.reason: C4's mandatory register lock: NULL-only, underpowered, absence-of-evidence not equivalence. The verbatim hedge ('does not account for THIS run-up; not that scrutiny never matters') must be kept and not strengthened.
evidence: claim_findings_ledger.json C4 referee_proof ('NULL ONLY -- underpowered; interaction CI [-0.027,+0.016]; 89% of calls draw no cash scrutiny') + thinnest_claim (verbatim hedge, 'Do NOT strengthen')

coverage.purpose_fully_delivered: Complete. P1 concedes the confound is genuine using the SIGNIFICANT incidence rise (HighCashScrutiny 0.0408**) rather than the insignificant volume coefficient, so the rule-out is not a strawman; P2-P4 deliver the three-step rule-out (measure real 0.7530*** -> scrutiny does not move the residual -0.0000 -> reason-gating leaves the run-up intact 0.0413***/0.0439** with interaction -0.0056 n.s.); P5 locks the NULL-only, underpowered register with the verbatim hedge. C4 delivered exactly at the ledger ceiling: scrutiny does not account for THIS run-up, with no strengthening. The 2.2-P5 + 2.5-P4 promise is paid off here and only here.
gaps: By design C4 is absence-of-evidence, not a powered equivalence test -- the underpowered, NULL-only status is disclosed as bounded-by-design, not concealed
4.1 does not establish the disclosure mechanism (rejecting one rival is not establishing a cause) -- mechanism stays open, consistent with the whole-thesis register
